description.ko: 전체 CPU 라이브러리 목표를 축소하지 않고 실제 소스·내장 연산·설계 표를 구분한다.
description.en: Keep the complete CPU target while separating source declarations, compiler-bound operations, and design contracts.

rules: cpu_callable_names counts distinct written qualified names, not implementation count.
cpu_signature_rows retains distinct documented signatures and merges exact duplicate rows.
Array/Vector/Slice documentation families overlap; their family totals are not disjoint language modules.
source_equivalents are explicitly recorded alternate calling forms from the test manifest.
Unmapped catalog names are unresolved coverage, not proof that the API is missing; builtin operations require separate semantic evidence.
Source declarations, comments, compiler marker declarations, and fixture paths do not prove current execution success.

prerequisites: Typed scalar intrinsics and explicit numeric conversion policies
Width-specific formatting/parsing, byte order and UTF-8/Unicode validation
Low-precision float representation and unsupported-capability behavior
Checked arithmetic and exact error payloads
cpu_groups.boundary: The released scalar/complex subset is narrower than the complete numeric and Unicode catalogs.

prerequisites: Move-aware element cleanup and partial initialization
Fallible growth that preserves accepted input
Projection-aware loans, disjoint mutable views and bounds validation
Closure-driven algorithms and ordering contracts
cpu_groups.boundary: Current source functions and compiler builtins use distinct calling forms; copied Array/Vector/Slice pages require canonical reconciliation.

prerequisites: Move/borrow-safe carrier transformations
Exact error types and explicit error mapping
Fn/FnMut/FnOnce call permissions and closure lifetime checks
cpu_groups.boundary: Source combinators are inventoried independently from compiler-owned constructors and predicates.

prerequisites: Owned UTF-8 storage versus borrowed views
Allocation failures, scalar boundaries and byte offsets
Search/split/trim/encoding contracts without hidden copies
Unicode classification/grapheme policy and reproducible tables
cpu_groups.boundary: Byte positions, Unicode scalar counts, and grapheme boundaries must remain distinct.

prerequisites: Typed allocation handles, Drop and failure-safe construction
Reference-count control-block lifetimes and weak upgrade
Thread-safe sharing eligibility and synchronized mutation
No pointer/integer or private-handle forgery
cpu_groups.boundary: A safe C++ owner alone does not complete the public generic Aevix API or borrow checking.

prerequisites: Eq/Hash/Ord contracts and borrowed-key lookup
Documented collision policy and randomized versus stable hashing
Allocation-preserving insert and entry APIs
Loan-safe mutation, ordered navigation and algebra
cpu_groups.boundary: Hash maps and ordered maps have different cost and invalidation contracts.

prerequisites: Native synchronization boundary and concrete memory-order validation
Move/borrow-safe guards and poisoning policy
Cross-thread ownership constraints and interior mutation
Shutdown behavior and no callback retention beyond loans
cpu_groups.boundary: CPU parallel for_each is not a substitute for these general synchronization APIs.

prerequisites: Structured task scopes, result ownership and joining
Cancellation as a request with explicit quiescence
Captured owner/borrow lifetime and cross-thread eligibility
Completion and cleanup on all paths
cpu_groups.boundary: Task.from_pending and all device-completion bridges remain GPU-deferred.

prerequisites: CPU buffer owners with checked shape products and strides
Static shape compatibility plus runtime validation
Injective mutable views and alias-safe into operations
Defined reductions, broadcasting, accumulator precision and quantization error policies
cpu_groups.boundary: CPU arithmetic remains in scope; device queues, GPU kernels, transfer plans, asynchronous copies and Pending are excluded.

prerequisites: Per-target element/lane profile validation
Consistent integer overflow and floating behavior
Worker call-graph, capture and storage restrictions
AArch64/x86-64 execution evidence on each claimed target
cpu_groups.boundary: Accepted checker operation names do not imply every broader portable-SIMD catalog signature is implemented.

prerequisites: Output operand evaluation and text-loan lifetime
Structured IO/parse/format errors and partial progress
Line versus token input and EOF
Explicit flushing and logging level identity
cpu_groups.boundary: Console intrinsics are separate from general File/Path/Process APIs.

prerequisites: Typed native handles and explicit close/flush Result
Partial IO, bounded reads and preserved progress
Lossless Unix byte paths and Windows UTF-16 paths
Metadata versus symlink metadata and explicit overwrite policy
Argument-vector spawn without implicit shell parsing
Child reaping, timeout, signals and exit status
Lossless environment values and executable paths
Monotonic duration and checked time arithmetic
Typed IDs/spans and selective interning
Stable content hashes distinct from randomized table hashing
Versioned AIR/cache serialization and corrupt-cache rejection
Temporary-output publication and allocation-failure injection

gpu_exclusion: All Pending pages and GPU-only queue/transfer/compilation rows are retained under excluded_gpu for traceability; they are not silently removed from the language plan.
completion_gate: Every claimed public contract needs real behavior, explicit error/ownership semantics, and appropriate execution/negative tests; no success-returning placeholders count as completion.

verified_checkpoint.result: 138/138 CTest passed in703.69 seconds on one coherent macOS ARM64 binary;3797 public declarations had current lifecycle metadata.
verified_checkpoint.boundary: This result identifies the recorded executable,526 frozen inputs and3797-declaration inventory. Later source/compiler changes require a new checkpoint. Complete CPU support and latest-source Linux/Windows execution are not claimed.

current_development_profile.source_support: 128 bytes functions;107 unicode functions including50 pinned Unicode17 UCD operations;108 floating functions;528 integer overloads across48 names plus24 constants;20 boolean functions;27 canonical Task name candidates plus extra blocking Task.wait. Source calling forms, nominal carriers and full catalog contracts remain distinct. Subsequent integrated additions include opaque TaskId, workerless Task.ready, Box.into_inner and29 range.* source overloads across18 names.

char_catalog_split.boundary: Source alternatives require explicit unicode import and do not implement the105 remaining Char namespace spellings. Scalar properties/default isolated-scalar mappings are not whole-string normalization, segmentation, bidi, locale/context casing or layout.

task_catalog_split.boundary: Provider presence is not exact signature/callback/carrier/cost/lifetime equivalence. Task.wait is outside the original59-row catalog and does not reduce its remainder.

current_development_profile.task_limits: Fully owned captures/results; concrete zero-argument compiler closures; conditional sealed Send/Sync plus transitive effect/cleanup checks; one native thread per spawned child; Task.ready creates no worker but retains fallible result/control allocation; retained lexical Scope observation loans. No borrowed/static views, nested scopes, worker-side spawn, global/persist Task storage, pools or detach in this tested profile.
current_development_profile.thread_transfer_limits: Shared/Weak require inner Send+Sync; Mutex derives Send/Sync from inner Send; RwLock Send needs inner Send and Sync needs inner Send+Sync. Atomic sealed facts cover bool and8/16/32/64-bit integers. All Send additionally requires worker-safe cleanup; contained borrows and owned Task admission restrictions remain. Guards are non-Send/non-Sync borrowed carriers. These facts do not complete the synchronization catalogs.
current_development_profile.byte_limits: Owning buffers and strict UTF8 adapters are now present; native-endian codecs, lazy iterators and exact canonical Byte/carrier contracts remain separate. Owned UTF8 decoding may validate again and copy through string.from_utf8.
current_development_profile.representation_limits: Exact raw bits and source classification/sign/magnitude/next/total-order/constants support f16,bf16,f32,f64. No f8 or automatic widening of low-precision math is inferred. Native C f32/f64 math is not a correctly-rounded cross-platform guarantee.
current_development_profile.numeric_carrier_limits: IntegerArithmeticError and BooleanError are source carriers, not aliases for every conceptual IntegerError, AllocError or BufferError signature. No canonical Integer namespace forwarding or all broader numeric contracts are certified.
current_development_profile.boundary: The registered154-test suite passed on b87fb39d with345 selected source inputs unchanged during the run. This local checkpoint does not complete all synchronous CPU catalog contracts. Async remains0.4 and GPU remains deferred. The explicitly requested bounded proof pass is opt-in; other held performance changes still await the final Claude advice.

integrated_suite.boundary: Registered local macOS ARM64 suite, including dedicated Ready/Box/Range materialization/proof gates; not every CPU catalog API or cross-target execution.
